prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A contemporary art gallery interior, softly lit with warm, ambient lighting. In the center of the composition, a large, striking black-and-white photograph dominates the wall. The photograph features a glamorous woman in a leather trench coat, exuding confidence and poise as she smokes a cigarette, her head tilted back and eyes half-closed, with wisps of smoke curling elegantly above her. The woman's pose is relaxed yet powerful, one hand in her pocket, the other holding the cigarette, evoking a sense of vintage film noir allure. In the foreground, two viewers—one male, one female—stand with their backs to the camera, gazing up at the photograph in quiet contemplation. Their silhouettes are softly out of focus, creating a sense of depth and drawing attention to the artwork. To the right, a modern wall sconce casts a gentle spotlight on the photograph, while a small bouquet of pink flowers and a few scattered objects add subtle color and life to the otherwise minimalist, cream-colored space. The overall mood is sophisticated and introspective, with a cinematic quality reminiscent of classic European art films.
